name: Sootopolis City
lines:
Listen up, my boygirl, and I’ll share something worth hearing.
People say there’s an ancient ruin in the sea around here.
There could be lost treasure waiting to be discovered!

Yes, ancient treasure...
It would be cool if it existed!
But even if there’s no treasure to be found, going on
an underwater stroll with my Pokémon is cool in itself!
